summary:
Main
The price recovery continued today across futures, port indices and seaborne quotations.DCE most traded closed at 691.0 yuan/mt, up 1.32%; the 61%, 58% and 65% port indices rose to 658, 609 and 820 yuan/wmt. The seaborne indices reached USD 91.75/dmt for the 61% and 107.70 for the 65%, with all 12 brands higher, indicating improved short-term pricing sentiment. However, prices and physical balances are not fully aligned.
